How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Ahmedabad Centre Research Fellow Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Ahmedabad to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Ahmedabad Centre Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Centre Research Fellow posts at IIM Ahmedabad is 15-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Centre Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Centre Research Fellow position at IIM Ahmedabad.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Centre Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD Degree in an analytical or human insights-focused field, or a PhD/FPM in Cognitive Science/Neuroscience, or the application of Behavioural Science to areas of Economics, Marketing or Finance.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Online.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Centre Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for the Centre Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The job type for the Centre Research Fellow position is Contractual.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIM Ahmedabad located?
faq.answer: IIM Ahmedabad is located in Ahmedabad, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q8. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: The notification does not specify any state-wise restrictions, so candidates from other states may be eligible if they meet the qualification criteria.

faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article once released.
